clauses: FINAL malicious-signing assumption for release-register: at most one of Aspen, Birch, Cedar and Dogwood can be Byzantine at a time. Any one named signer may be that one. No pair or larger simultaneous Byzantine set is permitted.

FINAL unavailability assumption for release-register: at most one of Aspen, Birch, Cedar and Dogwood can be unavailable at a time. Every individual outage is permitted, as is no outage. Simultaneous outages of two or more signers are excluded.
A superseded training draft allowed two malicious signers and simultaneous regional outages. That draft is withdrawn and does not describe this register.
